tools.name: sendlane_list_lists
tools.description: List the audience lists of the account: id, name, description, status, created date. GET /lists.

tools.name: sendlane_get_list
tools.description: One audience list by id. GET /lists/{listId}.

tools.name: sendlane_list_list_contacts
tools.description: Contacts on one list: email, name, phone, subscribed/suppressed state, tags, custom fields, lifetime value. GET /lists/{listId}/contacts.

tools.name: sendlane_list_list_unsubscribed
tools.description: Contacts that unsubscribed from one list. GET /lists/{listId}/unsubscribed.

tools.name: sendlane_list_contacts
tools.description: All contacts of the account: email, name, phone, lists, tags, custom fields, subscribed/suppressed state. Filter by creation time with from/to. GET /contacts.

tools.name: sendlane_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with lists, tags, custom fields, consent, lifetime value and subscribed/suppressed state. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sendlane_list_unsubscribed_contacts
tools.description: Contacts that unsubscribed from the account. GET /contacts/unsubscribed.

tools.name: sendlane_get_contact_subscriptions
tools.description: The list subscriptions of one contact: list, subscribed/suppressed state, who added it and when. GET /contacts/{contactId}/subscriptions.

tools.name: sendlane_get_contact_tags
tools.description: The tags on one contact. GET /contacts/{contactId}/tags.

tools.name: sendlane_get_contact_custom_fields
tools.description: The custom field values of one contact. GET /contacts/{contactId}/custom-fields.

tools.name: sendlane_list_tags
tools.description: The contact tags of the account: id, name, audience count. GET /tags.

tools.name: sendlane_get_tag
tools.description: One tag by id. GET /tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: sendlane_list_tag_contacts
tools.description: Contacts that carry one tag. GET /tags/{tagId}/contacts.

tools.name: sendlane_list_custom_fields
tools.description: The custom contact fields of the account: id, name, type. Use the ids when setting field values. GET /custom-fields.

tools.name: sendlane_list_segments
tools.description: The segments of the account: id, name, list, match rule, last count. GET /segments.

tools.name: sendlane_list_segment_contacts
tools.description: Contacts in one segment: id, email, name, phone. GET /segments/{segmentId}/contacts.

tools.name: sendlane_list_campaigns
tools.description: Email campaigns: id, name, status, scheduled and sent time, automation. GET /campaigns.

tools.name: sendlane_get_campaign
tools.description: One email campaign by id. GET /campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: sendlane_get_campaign_report
tools.description: Statistics of one email campaign: sent, opens, clicks (unique too), bounced, suppressed, unsubscribed, spam, revenue. from/to limit the period. GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/report.

tools.name: sendlane_list_sms_messages
tools.description: SMS messages (campaign and automation): id, name, campaign status, automation. GET /sms-messages.

tools.name: sendlane_get_sms_report
tools.description: Statistics of one SMS message: sent, delivered, clicks, failed, replies, unsubscribed, credits, revenue. from/to limit the period. GET /sms-messages/{messageId}/report.

tools.name: sendlane_list_sender_profiles
tools.description: The sender profiles (from name, from/reply email, postal address, default flag). GET /senders.

tools.name: sendlane_create_list
tools.description: WRITE: create an audience list. Not idempotent: calling it twice makes two lists. POST /lists.

tools.name: sendlane_update_list
tools.description: WRITE: rename a list and/or change its description (a full update: name is required, an omitted description may be cleared). PUT /lists/{listId}.

tools.name: sendlane_add_contacts_to_list
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more contacts (up to 100) to a list; a contact that does not exist is created. Each needs an email or a phone. Sendlane accepts the request for processing (HTTP 202). Only add people who agreed to receive marketing. POST /lists/{listId}/contacts.

tools.name: sendlane_remove_contact_from_list
tools.description: WRITE: remove one contact from one list (the contact stays in the account). DELETE /lists/{listId}/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sendlane_unsubscribe_contact
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe one contact from email marketing. The contact stops receiving campaigns. POST /contacts/{contactId}/unsubscribe.

tools.name: sendlane_create_tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact tag. POST /tags.

tools.name: sendlane_add_contact_tags
tools.description: WRITE: put one or more existing tags on a contact. POST /contacts/{contactId}/tags.

tools.name: sendlane_remove_contact_tag
tools.description: WRITE: remove one tag from a contact (the tag itself is kept). DELETE /contacts/{contactId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: sendlane_set_contact_custom_fields
tools.description: WRITE: add custom field values to a contact. Field ids come from sendlane_list_custom_fields. POST /contacts/{contactId}/custom-fields.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
